name: 85281 · Tempe, AZ
findings: ZIP 85281 (Tempe) has 188 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85281 (Tempe) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 2 arts and cultural organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.
